title: PETLIBRO Automatic Cat Feeder, 5G WiFi Automatic Dog Food Dispenser with Freshness Preservation, 5L Timed Pet Feeder with Low Food Sensor, Up to 10 Meals Per Day, Granary Black
say: Customers find the automatic feeder easy to set up and use, with precise food dispensing and great portion sizes. However, the WiFi connectivity is problematic as it frequently disconnects from the internet. Moreover, the device experiences reliability issues with the system going offline, and customers report jamming problems with food getting stuck in the rotating mechanism. The value for money receives mixed feedback, with some considering it worth the price while others find it not worth the cost.
